object_note: Apps report the pose of the STRIP CENTRE (marker axes), not of a tag: T_cam_strip = T_cam_tag * Translation(-offset_m). offset_m is the tag centre in strip axes; offset_q (x, y, z, w) is identity because both tags are upright on the strip.
marker_axes: marker axes (OpenCV ArUco convention): origin at the strip centre, x along the strip toward the 41h12 tag (to the right when TOP is up), y toward the TOP edge, z out of the printed face. Right-handed, metres. Both tags are upright on the strip, so each tag's own axes are parallel to the strip axes.
apriltag_lib_axes_note: the apriltag C library (and jp.keijiro.apriltag, pupil-apriltags) returns tag poses with x right, y DOWN, z INTO the tag; convert to marker axes with R_marker = R_apriltag * diag(1, -1, -1) (180 deg about x). OpenCV ArUco already uses marker axes.

tags.size_note: detector edge = outer edge of the black square (8 x 8 modules of 10 mm incl. the black border)
detector edge = INNER edge of the black ring (5 of the 9 modules, 57.14 mm). The black ring's outer edge is 80 mm (7 modules); the outermost ring of modules (102.86 mm) is data bits

print_check: print at 100 %: the ruler is 100 mm and BOTH black squares are 80 mm wide

placement.face: inside face: the face that is up in step 1, with the dowel holes and the groove for the drawer bottom
placement.position: strip centre on the old single-tag centre: centred along the 380 mm length; centred across the 130 mm height between the groove and the opposite long edge (the 210 x 105 mm strip fits; keep the groove and dowel holes clear)
placement.orientation: the printed TOP edge of the strip points toward the groove edge; strip x runs along the 380 mm length, marker z points out of the inside face
placement.fixing: flat, no bubbles: glue stick or low-tack spray; tape only on the white margin, never on the black
placement.visibility: visible in steps 1-4 (front lying flat, sides going on); hidden once the bottom panel slides in. Apps must hold the last good pose (anchor) when the marker is lost.
